name: Dual Phone AR
summary: Mobile AR in which a second phone acts as a handheld controller that casts a ray into the scene seen through the first phone.
howItWorks: One phone shows the AR view, the other is tracked and used to point at virtual objects, freeing the viewing phone from touch input.
